metadata.title: Semiconductor stocks retreat — and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
4 hours ago
Semiconductor stocks retreat — and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Thursday's premarket action:
Shares in Sandisk are down nearly 3% as semiconductor stocks come under pressure on investors worrying about rising memory-chip costs. Arm Holdings declined by about 2%, while Marvell Technology edged 1.5% lower.
Alphabet is down 1.5% following a top European court's dismissal of Google's appeal against a €4.1 billion ($4.68 billion) anticompetition fine.
Adobe rose 2% after HSBC lifted its rating from hold to buy and boosted the price target to $308 from $282.
